 Special Weather Statement is in effect CWLP customers can seek bill assistance starting Dec. 1 
 Eligible customers must first apply through the Sangamon County LIHEAP process. 
 A utility customer looks over their bill. (News 10 Lansing) By WAND Digital Staff Published : Nov. 16, 2026 at 12:43 PM CST | Updated : 20 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google SPRINGFIELD, Ill. (WAND) – Customers in need of help paying their CWLP bill can get assistance through the utility’s RELIEF program starting on Dec. 1. 
 Entering its 42nd year, the program provides financial assistance to customers in need. 
 The first step requires customers to apply for assistance through the Sangamon County LIHEAP process. Once that’s completed, customers should call the CWLP Project RELIEF appointment phone line at 217-78-2414. 
 Customers who meet eligibility requirements will then get an appointment with the program’s administrator at Fifth Street Renaissance. 
 To qualify, customers must:
 have a total household income of no more than 150% of the federal poverty guidelines based on household size (in the last 90 days) 
 a past due CWLP bill 
 have not received RELIEF assistance during the 2025-26 program season 
 have exhausted all assistance resources, including LIHEAP 
 have the ability to cover some of the past-due bill 
 Money for the program comes from customers who donate by adding $1 or more to their bill payments and from city employee payroll contributions.
